# Contact

We welcome enquiries from readers, industry professionals, regulators, and media.

## Follow us

The fastest way to get our news is our **WhatsApp channel**. Every official Tokenization 2050 channel:

{{SOCIAL_LIST}}

We only use the channels listed above. Accounts not listed here are not ours.

## Email

For news tips, press releases, story ideas, corrections, partnerships, or general questions:

**Email**: [{{CONTACT_EMAIL}}](mailto:{{CONTACT_EMAIL}})

To report an error, please include the article URL, the specific error, and supporting evidence. We review all correction requests and respond within 48 hours. See our [Corrections policy](/corrections/).

## Response Times

We aim to respond to all enquiries within two business days.
